gizmo.title: Ndụmọdụ nlebanya onwe onye
gizmo.description: Gwa nwa akwụkwọ ka o chee echiche banyere akara ma ọ bụ ọnọdụ obi ya, ma nye ya ndụmọdụ iji meziwanye onwe ya dabere na azịza ya.

configure.title: Ụdị ntinye
configure.description: Otú nwa akwụkwọ si ekwu ka o si eme. Ha abụọ na-eji ọkwa 0 ruo 4 (akara: F=0, D=1, C=2, B=3, A=4; ọnọdụ obi: dị ala nke ukwuu=0 ruo ọ magburu onwe ya=4).

configure.title: Ajụjụ
configure.description: Ajụjụ maka nwa akwụkwọ. Hapụ ya efu iji jiri ihe ndabara maka ụdị ntinye.

configure.title: Ndụmọdụ
configure.description: Nzaghachi a na-egosi maka ọnụọgụ azịza. A na-eji ọnụọgụ mbụ kwekọrọ.
